testAbsoluteDip.desc: Checks that a drop below the absolute FPS threshold produces an event on return to normal.

testRelativeDip.desc: Checks that a frame time above baseline * ratio produces an event.

testDipMustBeSustained.desc: Checks that a drop shorter than dipMinDurationMs produces nothing.

testRecoveryWithoutObservedDurationDoesN.desc: Checks that an episode with no observed duration (a single sample) does not emit an event.

testRecoveryEmitsWorstFrameOnce.desc: Checks that the worst frame is captured once then that the event is emitted on recovery.

testIntentionalCapDisablesAbsoluteTrigge.desc: Checks that with absoluteAllowed = false, a capped FPS does not trigger an absolute dip.

testOpenSustainedDipCanBeFinished.desc: Checks that finish() closes an open, sustained episode.

testLongDipIsSegmented.desc: Checks that an episode exceeding maxEpisodeMs is split.

testCooldownSuppressesDip.desc: Checks that the cooldown delay suppresses a new episode.

testSessionCapSuppressesDip.desc: Checks that maxDipEventsPerSession caps the number of events.
